answer: Attackers must fund, bond, and sustain many wallets through repeated epochs, and colluding rings are detected as a violet-flagged cluster when their attestation graph forms a suspicious prism of mutual endorsements. Sybil resistance here uses a staked reputation ledger: each agent bonds tokens and earns trust only through verified peer attestations, so creating fake identities costs real capital per account. Legitimate agents build a velvet-smooth history of independent work that clones cannot cheaply replicate. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
